name: TiRex-2 (NX-AI)
usage: Time-series forecasting: light, covariates, Mac CPU and MPS

licence.note: TiRex v1 was under the NXAI Community License

size_gb.note: safetensors only; the repository also holds a legacy model.ckpt (pickle) and model.onnx

runtimes.value: pip `tirex-2` (0.5.0); macOS CPU and MPS fixed (PR #10); covariates past and future; 9 quantiles

web.scope: Released 16.06.2026: all comments since release. Hacker News (promotional only), Hugging Face discussions (none), GitHub issues of tirex-2. Reddit not found. **Feedback thin.**
web.summary: Light alternative; quantile ordering bug on tiny-scale data fixed; benchmark leakage found by a reviewer and removed by the authors.

comments.text: Benchmarks (leads, not user feedback): TS-Arena 58.6 over 20 weeks on 14.11.2026, a live benchmark where forecasts are submitted before the data exists, mostly electricity data, higher is better ([TS-Arena](https://ts-arena.live)); GIFT-Eval relative CRPS / MASE 0.478 / 0.697, recalculated from the published result files, not the official ranking, lower is better ([results](https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/gift-eval/tree/main/results)).

Common to all forecasting foundation models: practitioners report they often do not beat simple baselines on their own data: TimesFM about ARIMA level while bigger and slower ([magimas, 31.03.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47583870)); seasonal naive usually wins for e-commerce ([jc4p, 19.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50155295)); one XGBoost model per series still wins ([niltecedu, 19.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50156050)); XGBoost and LightGBM beat transformers on blood glucose ([articulatepang, 14.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50498722)). The benefit is many series without building one model each ([logancbrown, 19.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50152506)). Backtest against a simple baseline first.

Quantiles out of order on very small-scale data, fixed in PR #101 ([tirex-2 #81, 21.10.2026](https://github.com/NX-AI/tirex-2/issues/81)); a reviewer found GIFT-Eval solar data in the training set, the authors removed it from their reported results ([#2, 05.07.2026](https://github.com/NX-AI/tirex-2/issues/2)).
